name: @meir-labs/skill-security-audit
description: The meirlabs security-audit skill — find real, exploitable issues and turn each into a ranked finding with an implementation plan: a threat model, a multi-lens static sweep, live-config checks, then a 3-skeptic adversarial verification pass so the report resists false positives. npx installs it into .claude/skills.
author: Meir Rosenschein
